title: East Ramapo school SLP pilot operating plan
status: New-company launch plan — not bid-ready: no confirmed therapists or insurance

charter.proposed_service: In-person school speech-language pathology, using one experienced SLP initially and a separately qualified backup. Add a second or third clinician only for authorized assignments with funded capacity.
charter.pilot_boundary: One buyer and one discipline. Prefer a geographically concentrated assignment with a defined timetable. Assignment size, caseload, sites, frequency and start date remain buyer decisions.
charter.employment_baseline: Agency-employed W-2 clinicians for planning and cost modelling. Confirm the actual entity, employer, labor obligations and contract structure before employment or bid representations. Backup availability and compensation require an agreement; standby is not assumed free.
charter.delivery: Therapy is in person. Licensed humans provide and document clinical services; the school retains IEP and service-authorization decisions. AI assists approved administrative workflows.
charter.records: Use the district's approved clinical and attendance-record process. Keep staffing evidence, actual worked time, invoice quantities and clinical service records distinct. Do not assume a specific district platform or API.
charter.initial_validation_window: Review the first 30 service days after an authorized start, then the first complete invoice-to-cash cycle. These are proposed management checkpoints, not promised contract duration.
out_of_scope: OT/PT, assistants or clinical fellows as automatic substitutes for the SLP profile
Independent IEP changes by an AI agent
Medicaid claim submission by the agency unless separately scoped and authorized

readiness.status: New-company setup required; evidence not supplied
readiness.proof: Exact bidder identity, NY business-registration evidence, ownership/employer structure, W-9, authorized signatory, organizational history and truthful performance narrative.
Consented clinician resumes, references, qualifications and genuine availability; separate backup plan. Do not list people who have not agreed to be proposed.
Required COI and insurer/bidder certification, with reconciled coverage limits, endorsements, dates, activities and legal-entity name.
Actual pay expectations, insurer/service quotes and approved fee units; fully loaded rate analysis, absence/cancellation treatment and working-capital capacity.
Current packet/addenda, all forms and notarizations, fee narrative, required attachments, submission access and final human authorization.
Executed agreement and district-authorized assignment/order with sites, dates, services, approvers and funding authority. Vendor selection alone is insufficient.
Current license/registration and school credentials; district-requested clearance, exclusion checks, training, orientation and approved records access.
Payroll and insurance live; attendance/service/time/invoice workflows rehearsed; approved data agreement, access, retention and incident handling; named accountable owners.

critical_path.deliverable: Inventory entity, signatory, current insurance, references, clinician roster and cash resources; appoint operating and clinical leads.
critical_path.exit: Each mandatory evidence item is available or has a named owner and credible completion date.

critical_path.deliverable: Assemble a real proposed SLP and backup pipeline; verify credentials, consent to inclusion, timetable, travel and pay expectations.
critical_path.exit: Named capacity can be supported without speculation; unresolved credential/clearance timing is visible.

critical_path.deliverable: Prepare insurer submission using the coverage matrix and request reconciliation of conflicting sample provisions.
critical_path.dependency: Accurate entity, payroll, operations and claims information
critical_path.exit: Insurer confirms obtainable coverage, cost, effective dates and bid-time evidence; no policy bought in this research.

critical_path.deliverable: Decide whether a truthful, complete and financially supportable October 30 response is feasible.
critical_path.exit: Proceed only with credible clinician, coverage, price and completion evidence; otherwise preserve the plan for the next permitted route.

critical_path.when: If the current bid cannot be completed truthfully
critical_path.deliverable: Finish company/employer setup, secure provider capacity and price coverage, then verify the next district-permitted procurement or addition route. Do not assume rolling entry, a late submission or subcontract permission.
critical_path.exit: A verified lawful purchasing route before promising East Ramapo work; startup work can proceed independently of an award.

critical_path.deliverable: Finalize the consolidated purchasing questions from this pack and check the latest addenda.
critical_path.dependency: Unresolved bid, insurance, units, payment, data and clinician questions
critical_path.exit: One reviewed question list; contact only through the RFP's authorized channel when instructed.

critical_path.deliverable: RFP question deadline; recheck any subsequent changes before action.
critical_path.exit: If sent, retain transmission evidence and published responses; no questions sent by this research.

critical_path.deliverable: Complete all narrative attachments, fees, insurance evidence, signatures and notarizations; independently compare with the current RFP and addenda.
critical_path.owner: Bid lead, signatory, broker and notary as applicable
critical_path.exit: No unsupported factual representation or unfilled mandatory field. Review price assumptions against the offered scope.

critical_path.deliverable: Electronic proposal deadline in the reviewed RFP; target earlier completion to allow upload problems.
critical_path.dependency: Final approved package and current portal instructions
critical_path.exit: Submission, if later authorized and performed, requires the actual acceptance receipt. No bid is submitted by this plan.

critical_path.when: After award and before first service
critical_path.deliverable: Complete district onboarding, funded assignment, provider clearance, payroll, insurance, approved record access and workflow rehearsal.
critical_path.exit: Named human release decision with evidence; no service starts solely because a contract was awarded.

critical_path.when: First 30 service days, then first collected invoice
critical_path.deliverable: Review coverage, service/documentation exceptions, worked-time accuracy, invoice acceptance, collections and cost per assignment.
critical_path.exit: Scale only after quality, staffing, cash and buyer acceptance are demonstrated; compare with the assumptions in the model.

operating_cadence.control: Verify qualifications and clearances, effective coverage and scope, school authorization, current assignment and required access.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Compile evidence and flag gaps; no autonomous clearance.

operating_cadence.control: Confirm attendance/coverage; clinician records delivered or missed services in the approved process; worker records all actual compensable work separately.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Send approved reminders, detect missing administrative evidence and route exceptions; no invented service notes or hours.

operating_cadence.control: Reconcile district-required service logs and worked time, resolve absences and documentation gaps, and prepare payroll evidence.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Reconcile authorized metadata, show discrepancies and create review queues.

operating_cadence.frequency: Monthly and at relevant status changes
operating_cadence.control: Complete required exclusion checks and credential/coverage reviews; route potential matches to qualified human review.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Track due dates and capture permitted verification evidence; never treat a name-only match as a final finding.

operating_cadence.frequency: Service date plus fewer than 30 calendar days
operating_cadence.control: Deliver the required invoice and attendance evidence before the district's 30-day submission limit; use an internal earlier target after the unit/cadence is agreed.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Prepare a reconciled invoice draft, age missing evidence and escalate well before deadline; do not label the deadline as payment terms.

operating_cadence.frequency: On absence, incident, exclusion, expiry or disputed record
operating_cadence.control: Pause the affected approval or assignment as appropriate; notify the accountable human; retain history; district/clinical team decides clinical recovery.
operating_cadence.ai_role: Detect, queue, draft and audit within approved permissions. Safety-critical notifications must not depend on an unattended AI queue.

proposed_success_measures.target: 100% of assigned clinicians have verified, current applicable evidence before student contact.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Human-approved readiness record and source-verification timestamps; proposed control target.

proposed_success_measures.target: All scheduled assignment gaps are visible and escalated; target fulfillment level agreed with buyer after actual scope is known.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Scheduled, attempted, delivered, canceled and missed events remain distinct; no automatic compensatory-service decisions.

proposed_success_measures.target: All required weekly logs and invoice/attendance packages meet the applicable deadlines.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Submission receipts and reconciliation status; distinguish our completion from district acceptance.

proposed_success_measures.target: No worked time withheld solely because a client invoice is delayed or disputed.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Separate time approval, payroll and receivable histories.

proposed_success_measures.target: Positive contribution after actual delivery, admin and coverage costs, and sufficient cash through the observed collection cycle.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Reconciled actuals against the illustrative economics model; no assumed guaranteed utilization.

proposed_success_measures.target: Zero unauthorized external actions or unsupported clinical/financial decisions; establish actual administrative touch-time baseline during the pilot.
proposed_success_measures.measurement: Action log, human interventions, errors, retries and time per workflow. No achieved automation percentage claimed.

privacy_requirements.requirement: Agree the district's data-security/privacy contract and approved workflow before receiving student data.
privacy_requirements.implementation: Identify permitted purposes, data elements, records location, authorized people/subprocessors, retention/deletion and incident process. Include the applicable Parents' Bill of Rights and training evidence.

privacy_requirements.requirement: Keep pupil clinical and attendance evidence in the district-approved route; minimize copies into the staffing workspace.
privacy_requirements.implementation: Use approved references and aggregate status where adequate. Opaque student identifiers can still be protected; document re-identification/access risks. Do not send source clinical files or attendance details to a generic AI workspace.

privacy_requirements.requirement: Evaluate each tool and subprocessor for the exact data and contract purpose.
privacy_requirements.implementation: MFA, role-scoped access, encrypted transfer/storage, auditable changes and deletion/export controls are release requirements. A security badge or inventory listing is not district approval or permission to train models.

open_company_inputs: Proposed company name, legal formation/registration status and signing authority
New recruiting pipeline: no therapists confirmed; obtain consented primary/backup availability and credentials
New insurance placement: no policies confirmed; broker, underwriting inputs and actual quotes required
Approved compensation approach and real provider pay expectations
Named business, clinical, recruiting and privacy owners
actions_performed: Public research, proposed operating design, draft planning materials and illustrative calculations only. No recruitment messages, reference calls, broker requests, company registration, software purchase, bid submission or district contact.

company_baseline.source: User confirmation in this conversation, October 20, 2026
company_baseline.legal_entity: Formation/registration evidence not supplied; starting-company baseline
company_baseline.consequence: Named clinician capacity and bid-time insurance requirements are not currently met. The October 30 response is conditional, not a committed launch milestone. Do not certify readiness, implemented policies or capacity that does not exist.

capital_release_sequence.rule: Approve a capped at-risk preparation budget for entity/employer advice, recruiting and verification, bid preparation and required policy implementation. Winning work is not assured.

Obtain the required insurance certificate and signed insurer/bidder acknowledgments. A nonbinding broker quote is not the COI. Coverage placement may require a deposit or premium before award; obtain actual cash and cancellation terms before spending.

capital_release_sequence.stage: After an authorized assignment, before hiring/start commitments
capital_release_sequence.rule: Reserve cash for payroll, coverage, operations and collection delays using actual quotes and approved scope. Keep commercial margin and cash liquidity as separate gates.

Review weekly cash exposure, declining utilization and receivable aging. Fund contractually required continuing professional-liability coverage after work ends; first-year allowances do not prove that later obligation is funded.
